name: TrailReplay Agent Tools

network.terrain: Fetches public AWS Terrarium elevation tiles.
network.evaluate: Fetches public AWS Terrarium elevation tiles.

privacy: Route files and recipes are read locally. Terrain commands send requested tile coordinates to the public AWS Terrarium tile service; route files are not uploaded. No AI credentials or TrailReplay upload API are used.

commands.inspect: Read route and recipe context, resolve anchors with TrailReplay's shared parser and recipe engine, and report warnings.
commands.terrain: Sample bounded public Terrarium elevation data and produce terrain context for camera authoring.
commands.evaluate: Numerically evaluate recipe camera keyframes against terrain samples. This does not verify visual rendering.

replayArchiveScope: Extracts GPX/KML route files only. Pass --recipe separately; project.json is not read.
